name: a book
text: On Chromatographic Alchemy:  As far as current research allows, only certain very specific solutions can hold particular magical effects.  Fortuitously, these may be distinguished by color.  E.g., yellow for healing, red for curing of poison, purple for protection, brown for speed, and black for invisibility.  A clear solution is required for mana restoring potions, but certain other potations can also be so suspended.
